properties.description: A contract records paradigm, payload format, schema, endpoint, operations, auth, transport security and error model; UNRECORDED FIELDS READ AS `unspecified` NOT `none` (the flattering default would tell a consumer an unspecified contract is open); filling one field leaves the others and the name alone, so a spec completed by several people over time loses nothing; an invented enum value is refused rather than stored; and performance limits bind the interface as a Constraint via CONSTRAINS rather than as duplicate properties. PLUS `medium` (BL-129, 2026-08-01): settable through this tool at last — round-trips, leaves the rest of the spec alone, and an invented medium is refused with the stored value untouched. The reachability half lives in tests/structural.rs, where the same two-subsystem bridge built the way a user actually builds it now earns the library/data foundation exemption from single_point_of_failure, still fires when the medium is never stated, and still fires for REST. (crates/reflow2-core/tests/interface_spec.rs, 8 cases)
properties.name: A contract records its agreement axes, and unrecorded reads as unspecified not none
